title: Best MCP Servers for Developers in 2026: The Essential Toolkit (with Setup Guide)
summary: The 8 best MCP servers that actually improve your Claude Code and Cursor workflow — ranked by usefulness with setup instructions and real screenshots.
body_markdown: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server is a standardized integration that gives AI coding agents access to external tools and services. Without MCP, your agent can only read what you paste into the chat. With MCP servers, your agent can query your database, create GitHub PRs, search the web, and deploy apps directly. Blink's MCP server is the fastest way to give your agent full-stack deployment capabilities.
